title: Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.06859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. translated_title: 平衡层次化表示与量化：文本嵌入中的性能权衡
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06859v1 公告类型： new 摘要： 层次化文本嵌入模型提供可变长度的表示，而量化则降低数值精度；两者都旨在提高计算效率。本工作是一项实证基准研究，探讨这两种相互正交且已被广泛确立的技术之间的交互作用。我们使用四个基于Transformer的嵌入模型，在大规模文本嵌入基准（MTEB）的38个任务上进行评估，涵盖一维和二维层次化表示，并结合32位、8位和二值量化，每个任务共168种配置。我们分别报告每个效率维度：每个向量的理论存储开销和端到端评估时间。在Friedman检验及Nemenyi事后分析下，int8量化在配对分类和重排序任务中与float32在统计上无显著差异，总体性能损失最多为1.5个百分点；而二值量化在所有任务类别中均显著更差。将嵌入（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过每任务168种配置的大规模基准实验，首次系统评估了层次化嵌入表示与量化的交互作用，发现8-bit量化几乎不损害文本嵌入性能（最多损失1.5个百分点），而二值量化在所有任务类别中均显著退化，为文本嵌入的效率优化提供了实证权衡依据。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale benchmarking of 168 configurations per task, this study systematically reveals how hierarchical embedding representations interact with quantization, showing that int8 quantization preserves text embedding performance (at most 1.5 percentage points loss) while binary quantization significantly degrades it across all task categories, providing an empirical trade-off guide for embedding efficiency optimization.
